text.en: A child wishes to be a hawker, a gardener and a watchman.

In the morning when the gong sounds ten and the child walks to school, he meets the hawker crying bangles, crystal bangles. The hawker has no road he must take and no time to return, so the child wishes to be one.
At four in the afternoon, returning from school, he sees through a gate the gardener digging with his spade. The gardener does what he likes, gets dusty and nobody scolds him. The child wishes to be a gardener.
In the evening when it gets dark and his mother sends him to bed, he sees the watchman walking up and down. The lane is dark and lonely, the street lamp stands like a giant with one red eye, and the watchman swings his lantern with his shadow beside him and never goes to bed. The child wishes to be a watchman.
The new words are vocation, gong, lane, giant, spade and lantern.

problem.en: Name the three people the child admires.

prompt.en: Why does the child admire these people?

requiredIdeas.en: No one sends them to bed
